brief: The 5-step sleep ritual that fixed my insomnia.

slots.headline: Could Five Steps Fix Insomnia?
slots.subtitle: A simple nightly routine that finally put my racing mind to bed.

slots.title: Start The Wind-Down Hour
slots.body: I used to scroll until 2 AM. Now I power down all screens sixty minutes before sleep. That single boundary changed everything. My brain finally got the memo that day was done.

slots.title: Dim The Lights Early
slots.body: Bright bulbs trick your circadian rhythm into thinking it is still noon. I switch to lamps and candles at 9 PM sharp. The instant darkness signals melatonin to start its shift.

slots.title: Brain Dump On Paper
slots.body: Anxious thoughts love to party at midnight. I spend five minutes jotting every worry and task into a cheap notebook. Once they live on paper, my mind stops rehearsing them.

slots.title: Take A Warm Shower
slots.body: Heat raises your core temperature. The cool-down period afterward mimics the natural drop your body needs to fall asleep. I emerge relaxed, drowsy, and ready to collapse.

slots.title: Read A Paper Book
slots.body: No tablets, no phones, no exceptions. I keep a stack of boring paperbacks on my nightstand. Ten pages of mediocre fiction and my eyelids start their descent.

slots.title: Box Breathing In Bed
slots.body: I inhale for four, hold for four, exhale for four. This simple box pattern slows my heart rate and dissolves the static. Sleep arrives instead of frustration.

slots.headline: Reclaim Your Rest Tonight
slots.body: Save this post and try the full ritual tonight. Your best sleep might be one routine away.
